name: Home Control
description: Show and toggle Home Assistant entities with a tap (REST API)

ha.label: Home Assistant token
ha.description: Long-lived access token (Profile > Security in Home Assistant)

ha_url.name: Home Assistant address
ha_url.description: Local address with port, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123 (https is not supported)

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Tiles in display order. Tap toggles lights, switches, fans and similar; runs scenes, scripts and buttons.
